comments.author: Aramisko
comments.body_html: Hello. Thanks for the mod. I’d like to share my method for using it. I’m playing with the flea market turned off. Left only the gunsmith and the armorer (the rest are imbalanced in my opinion.) The calculation is based on the base price and is 3. This is approximately the same as the flea market price. This compensates for the complete availability of everything. As you progress, parts are unlocked from regular merchants and the cost of the raid decreases. I also want to say that it is very convenient to sell everything at the gunsmith. Its prices are slightly higher than the others, which allows mods to determine the price to work well.

comments.author: Suntion
comments.body_html:
Required Information

To fix this issue, please be sure to provide the following information. I will not be able to locate the specific ammunition box logic without these details.

  1. Item English Name:

    • Example: Ammunition box 5.56x45 or Magazine case
    • Hint: If you don’t know the English name, you can provide a screenshot or describe what it looks like / what it is used for in the game.

  2. Item Template ID (if known):

    • How to obtain: If you have a mod/tool installed in the game that displays IDs, please fill this in. If not, leave it blank and I will look it up by name.

Optional Information

Providing the following information can help me reproduce and fix the issue more quickly, especially if the issue is related to mod conflicts.

  1. SPT Version:

    • Example: 4.0.13

  2. Your Mod Name Version:

    • Example: 1.0.0

  3. Do you have any other mods installed that modify ammunition or containers?

    • If yes, please list their names. This helps rule out compatibility conflicts.

  4. Log Files:

    • If possible, please upload the .log file(s) from the SPT\user\logs\spt folder corresponding to the time the issue occurred.
    • These contain some debug information from this mod that can help with troubleshooting.

  5. Screenshots:

    • A screenshot showing the ammunition box interface or the issue is often worth a thousand words.

Could you please submit an issue on GitHub regarding this problem, following the above template and including as much detailed information as possible?
